parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The ID of the application. Call the [ListApplication](~~149390~~) operation to obtain this ID.

parameters.name: ScalingBehaviour
parameters.description: The configuration of custom scaling behaviors. For more information about the data structure, see the example.

parameters.name: ScalingRuleEnable
parameters.description:
The status of the Auto Scaling policy.

- **true**: enabled

- **false**: disabled

parameters.name: ScalingRuleName
parameters.description: The name of the Auto Scaling policy.

parameters.name: ScalingRuleTrigger
parameters.description: The trigger policy, which is a JSON string of a ScalingRuleTriggerDTO object. For more information about the format, see the Additional information about request parameters section.

parameters.name: ScalingRuleType
parameters.description:
The type of the Auto Scaling policy. Only the following type is supported:

- trigger: a trigger-based policy.
